simple.meaning: נִין (nîyn) is a Hebrew word meaning “progeny.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נִין (H5209) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 21:23, with occurrences in Genesis, Job, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נִין (H5209) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נִין (H5209) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: נִין (nîyn) / H5209 is traced through Genesis 21:23, Job 18:19, Isaiah 14:22 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
